rule: Fixed development sample. Rows of the private normalized layer with a checksum-valid corporate number and a corporate/public-body 法人種別, sorted by (file_date, corporate_number, sequence_number), first N kept, restricted to the SAMPLE_FIELDS allowlist. Regenerated only by `node scripts/build-data.mjs --refresh-sample`, never by a normal build, so the committed bundles stay reproducible without the private store.
